statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent palpitations
The patient has a history of atherosclerotic heart disease of the native coronary artery (I25.10)
The patient has nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency (I34.0)
Mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring (CPT 93229) was billed
The service was denied under reason code CO-22
Mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring is medically necessary to correlate symptomatic episodes with underlying arrhythmias
Mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring is medically necessary to assess the efficacy of current management strategies
The denial was based on coordination of benefits protocols with a primary insurer
